After reviewing French law on media, it is clear that France does not maintain a broad list of banned music recordings. Only recordings that contain content that violates criminal statutes—such as hate‑speech, extremist propaganda, or child‑sexual abuse material—can be deemed illegal, and such cases are extremely rare. No entire catalogues or well‑known artists (e.g., The Pogues, Prodigy, Sex Pistols, The Beatles) are prohibited. Therefore the most accurate statement is that **very few, if any, music records are illegal in France**.
